title: Container engines (Docker / Podman)
_comment: kind:container categories reclaim space from container engines. For each engine listed in 'engines' that is (a) one of the built-in whitelist docker/podman/nerdctl, (b) installed, and (c) running, the tool measures reclaimable space via '<engine> system df' and, on clean, runs the FIXED command '<engine> system prune -af'. The command is hard-coded (never taken from JSON) and volumes are NEVER pruned, so named volumes / databases stay safe. For docker it first empties each docker-container buildx builder's BuildKit cache — a named volume (buildx_buildkit_<node>_state) that 'system df' counts as in use, so 'system prune' never frees it. It is sized from that volume and cleaned with the FIXED 'docker buildx prune --builder <name> -af' (a stopped builder is started for it and stopped again), so even that volume is never deleted. See docs/DESIGN.md#buildx-builders.

categories.name: Docker / Podman reclaimable data
categories.desc: Stopped containers, unused images, build cache & buildx builders' caches ('system prune -af', 'buildx prune -af'). Named volumes are never deleted.
